ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BOS.name: Devin Carter
BOS.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

BKN.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
BKN.comment: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

BKN.name: Tyler Bilodeau
BKN.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

CHA.name: Grant Williams
CHA.comment: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

CHA.name: Coby White
CHA.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

CHA.name: Kylan Boswell
CHA.comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

CHI.name: Patrick Williams
CHI.comment: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

CHI.name: Nic Claxton
CHI.comment: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

DAL.name: Naji Marshall
DAL.comment: Marshall (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Heat.

DAL.name: Caleb Martin
DAL.comment: Martin (thumb) is out for Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.comment: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.

DAL.name: Santi Aldama
DAL.comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

DEN.name: Spencer Jones
DEN.comment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Monday's matchup with the Warriors.

DEN.name: Alpha Diallo
DEN.comment: Diallo (wrist) is out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

DEN.name: Cameron Johnson
DEN.comment: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to play Monday against the Warriors.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

DET.name: Ausar Thompson
DET.comment: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against New York.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.comment: Joe (hip) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

GS.name: Gui Santos
GS.comment: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left knee tendinitis.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Charles Bassey
GS.comment: Bassey is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to right patellar tendinopathy.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.comment: Williams is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left lower back soreness.

HOU.name: Marcus Smart
HOU.comment: Smart (arm) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Andrew Nembhard
IND.comment: Nembhard (neck/back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: Ivica Zubac
IND.comment: Zubac (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.comment: Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: T.J. McConnell
IND.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Max Strus
LAC.comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

LAL.name: Adou Thiero
LAL.comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

LAL.name: Cameron Carr
LAL.comment: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

MEM.name: Isaiah Stewart
MEM.comment: Stewart is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Jazz due to left ankle injury management.

MEM.name: Karim Lopez
MEM.comment: Lopez (knee) is questionable for Monday's game in Utah.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NO.name: Yves Missi
NO.comment: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

NY.name: Jose Alvarado
NY.comment: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Tuesday's game against the Pistons.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.comment: Holmgren (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.comment: Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.comment: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

OKC.name: Nikola Topic
OKC.comment: Topic (back) won't play in Monday's game against the Suns, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns, per Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic.

OKC.name: Otega Oweh
OKC.comment: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Jalen Suggs
ORL.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

PHI.name: VJ Edgecombe
PHI.comment: Edgecombe (abdomen) is out for Sunday's game against the Pistons, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

PHI.name: Joel Embiid
PHI.comment: Embiid has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit due to right plantar fasciitis management.

PHI.name: Dominick Barlow
PHI.comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

PHI.name: Tacko Fall
PHI.comment: Fall (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHI.name: Jabari Walker
PHI.comment: Walker has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pistons due to left knee soreness.

PHX.name: Oso Ighodaro
PHX.comment: Ighodaro (oblique) is out for Monday's matchup with the Thunder.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

POR.name: Scoot Henderson
POR.comment: Henderson is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Lakers due to left ankle soreness.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.comment: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

POR.name: Branden Carlson
POR.comment: Carlson (concussion) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

SAC.name: Keegan Murray
SAC.comment: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

SAC.name: Dylan Cardwell
SAC.comment: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.comment: Harris (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.comment: Leonard is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee swelling, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

UTAH.name: Jaxson Hayes
UTAH.comment: Hayes (shoulder) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

UTAH.name: Trey Alexander
UTAH.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.comment: Champagnie has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against Charlotte due to a right foot injury, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG) and two rebounds in four minutes.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

WSH.name: AJ Dybantsa
WSH.comment: Dybantsa, who has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hornets, is progressing well from a left ankle sprain and will take part in on-court activities Tuesday, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
